reason: After #832 ordinary-merged the global mandatory executed-test coverage reconciliation with 4 of 14 target evidence rows mechanically covered and 10 explicitly classified COVERAGE_GAP_PREREQUISITE, authorize one Fast Landing tests-only batch that adds four finding-family mandatory WP0 contracts. The batch must determine on fresh exact-head Stage whether the ten residual historical rows are already satisfied by current production or expose fresh causal RED. No production/root fix is authorized here.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

failureFirst.ifAllTestsPass: The tests-only candidate may proceed through exact-head gates and ordinary merge as coverage closure evidence. A later ledger-only reconciliation may reclassify the ten coverage gaps; Known Finding source/gate state remains independent.
failureFirst.ifAnyTestFails: Freeze the exact tests-only head as immutable causal RED evidence. Classify every failing subtest and reach unknownBlockers=0. Do not modify the frozen tests and do not change production under this authorization; any live root requires a separate prerequisite production authorization scoped to the proven root.

crossPlatformEgress: Exercise supported Telegram and Facebook public send entrypoints through their canonical durable/authorization seam into the physical provider seam without network access.

Assert both platforms expose a compatible supported-capability contract for public invocation, persisted/durable attempt identity, physical dispatch, structured accepted/failure result and exactly-once provider invocation under the tested path.
Preserve Facebook Worker/Durable authority and Chatwoot Matrix ownership; do not restore duplicate direct-CDN or alternate physical authority.
Do not infer parity by concatenating unrelated tests; the new contract itself must exercise both platforms.
durableExecution: Exercise canonical heartbeat, succeed, fail, waitRemote, cancel, retry and deadLetter operation semantics through repository-owned Durable Execution authority/repository seams.
Exercise appendV2Event sequence allocation under competing writes through the real transaction/write-host seam and require unique monotonic sequence integrity without duplicate sequence acceptance.
Exercise a long-running lease lifecycle where heartbeat extension preserves valid terminalization and stale/expired ownership remains fail-closed.
Do not treat source BEGIN IMMEDIATE text or API presence as proof; the mandatory test must execute the behavior.
aiCore: Exercise aiGateway admission failure after durable SCHEDULED persistence and require deterministic terminalization rather than stranded SCHEDULED state.
Exercise cancel-vs-succeed competition through canonical generation/object-fingerprint fencing and require a single valid terminal outcome with stale competitor rejection.
Exercise stale/superseded semantics across contextAwareReplyBrain, aiGateway and the turn/coordinator boundary with no stale result publication.
Exercise representative deterministic reply-generation failures and bounded latency/failure behavior so one failing layer does not enter an unbounded retry/await chain.
safeModeWriteBoundary: Enumerate repository-owned backend command/write classification rather than a hand-picked UI list.
When Safe Mode is active, require every classified backend write entrypoint to fail closed except the exact explicitly supported recovery command set.
Require command-owned classification and internal-actor checks to remain authoritative; caller-supplied write or actor metadata must not bypass the boundary.
Do not use the UI Safe Mode banner or staged-secret scanner as write-boundary proof.

requiredValidation.stage: Fresh exact-head Stage PRODUCT_WP0 must execute all four new tests through package.json test:wp0 -> tools/wp0/run-tests.js and must not merely prove file presence.

forbiddenSemantics: No production/runtime source mutation in this authorization or tests-only implementation.
No tools/wp0/run-tests.js, package.json, workflow, routing-policy, dependency, lockfile, database migration, packaging, release-binary or release-ledger mutation.
No network-dependent provider call or real external account requirement in the mandatory tests.
No weakening, mocking away or bypassing the canonical durable/fencing/security authority that the contract is meant to prove.
No mutation of historical frozen RED/evidence PRs.
No reset, force-push, amend, rebase, squash, cherry-pick or history rewrite.

reviewedCandidates.name: Existing Yance node:test mandatory WP0 runner and service seams
reviewedCandidates.source: node:test + tests/wp0/*.test.js + tools/wp0/run-tests.js + existing service/repository test seams
reviewedCandidates.reason: All four coverage families can be expressed with existing node:test, deterministic local fakes and repository-owned authority seams; no new framework is needed.

retireOrAvoid: Do not add a second test runner, generalized coverage database, new mock framework or network harness.
Do not split the ten ledger gaps into ten authorization PRs when four finding-family contracts can classify them in one mandatory Stage batch.
Do not pre-authorize production changes before a fresh tests-only run proves a live root.
Do not start packaged RC/UAT from this coverage package.
